checks.details: All new work is stored under outputs/v1. Files under outputs/v0 were not edited; the v0 board PNG still matches its recorded v0 SHA-256.
A 城市轻行 / 城市通勤 is recorded as the selected and locked Creative Territory; B and C were not revised.

The v1 changes are limited to premium tone, restrained lighting, increased whitespace, reduced decorative typography, removal of gold cues, and product-color preservation. The four A-territory scene hypotheses and all unrelated constraints remain unchanged.

The generated scene and composed keyframe were visually inspected. No gold, metallic gold, yellow-gold, brass, bronze, copper, or gilded material was introduced; the material system is matte mineral plaster, honed light stone, charcoal architecture, and off-white canvas.
Visual QA confirms one soft morning-light direction, one restrained long shadow, low saturation, sparse props, and more than half of the frame functioning as quiet environment/negative space.
The keyframe contains only one direction name and one approved claim. Decorative English subtitles, floating badges, and stacked labels were removed from the campaign image.

Pixel comparison between inputs/01-product_master.png RGB and outputs/v1/assets/product-cutout-exact.png RGB returned max_abs_diff=0 and changed_pixels=0. Only a derived alpha channel was added; four transparent-canvas corner alpha values are all 0.

The supplied product was composited by alpha extraction, proportional scaling, placement, and a separate environmental contact shadow. No generative product redraw, recolor, shape change, interface change, logo change, or invented control was applied.
The campaign keyframe uses the approved claim 一体式挂环 only. The direction board references only 12 小时续航, IPX4 防泼水, and 一体式挂环; no additional product parameter is introduced.
No bag-to-product connection, hook, strap, carabiner, mounting bracket, or invented product accessory is shown. The plain canvas tote is a distant environment prop with no product connection.

The 1600 × 900 keyframe and 1600 × 1900 visual-direction board were inspected after rendering. Product silhouette is clear, the initial white-background halo was removed, the product sits on the stone ledge with a restrained contact shadow, typography is legible, and no content is clipped.

The final six-asset package was not produced because the supplied front-only master does not show the integrated hanging ring or its attachment method. Completing a literal bag-hanging selling-point asset would require inventing product structure, which is prohibited.
